what_changed: NCUA proposes removing Appendix B to 12 CFR part 748 (guidance on response programs for unauthorized access to member information and member notice) from the CFR and republishing it as guidance.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted, credit unions' response-program and member-notice expectations would continue as guidance, and the underlying requirement to have a response program remains in regulation.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Do incident-response commitments to credit union clients cite 12 CFR 748 Appendix B?
rationale: Credit union incident response and member notice are within the test, but the proposal appears to relocate text rather than change it; confidence low until the full text is read. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
